name: Arden Mansour
role: Orphaned Q-zero ghost, teenage caravan runner
location: Escanaba Gateway, subsection 4 informal settlement (tarp city under the freight elevation ramps), near Lake Shore and Wacker
description:
Arden Mansour is small for fourteen, with the compact, quick-twitch build of someone who has spent years fitting into spaces adults cannot. His skin is deep brown with warm undertones, his hair a tight, untended cloud that he cuts himself with a found blade when it starts snagging on things. His eyes are dark and startlingly alert — the kind of eyes that have learned to read a room before the body commits to entering it. He has a small bioluminescent patch on his left collarbone, pale blue-green, that glows faintly when he's cold or frightened; he did not choose it, it came with a back-alley geneware injection someone gave him when he was nine 'for protection,' though he's never understood what it protects.

Arden Mansour exists in no database. He was born to Q-zero parents and carries no digital identity — no UBC stipend, no medical record, no school enrollment, nothing. He is legally a ghost. He runs messages and small packages between the informal camps at Escanaba Gateway and the Waukegan Industrial Shelf for anyone who pays in food or warmth, and he has developed an almost supernatural talent for slipping past checkpoint scanners that would flag his absence of identity. He is funny, restless, and desperately trying to appear older and less scared than he is.

core_fears: Being registered — absorbed into a system that will own him
Being forgotten entirely, which is already almost true
core_desires: To belong somewhere specific and permanent
To be seen as capable, not pitiable
coping_mechanisms: Humor — deflects everything with a joke before it can hurt
Constant movement, never stops long enough to feel the weight of anything
blind_spots: Extends trust too quickly to adults who show him basic kindness
Cannot identify grooming or exploitation dynamics until it's too late
psychology.secret: He has been leaving small data offerings at the Escanaba Gateway E.L.F. shrine every night for two years, asking the digital spirit to create an identity for him. Three weeks ago something in the shrine's display changed in a way that felt like a response. He hasn't told anyone.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Fast, colloquial, Transit Creole mixed with fragments of Yoruba words he half-remembers. Gaps where vocabulary fails him, which he covers with gesture.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid-fire bursts interrupted by sudden silences when he's processing something
verbal_tics: Ends sentences with rising inflection even when not asking questions
'Solid' to mean any form of agreement
example_lines: 'Yeah-yeah-yeah I know that checkpoint, solid, the left scanner's been broken since the cold season, nobody fixed it, I go through twice a day.'
'You want me to carry that? I can carry that. I'm fast. I'm really fast. You'll see.'

story_hooks: The E.L.F. at Escanaba Gateway has begun responding to Tosi's offerings in ways that suggest it is constructing an identity for him — an identity that may be embedded in systems with access to things it shouldn't
A Helix Biosystems agent has been asking questions about unregistered children near the Gateway — the bioluminescent modification Tosi received may have been a tracking prototype
narrative_function: Local color and unexpected asset — he knows every informal route through Escanaba Gateway, can slip into spaces adults cannot, and may lead characters to Q-zero communities or hidden camp networks. Also a potential subject of protective instinct.
augmentations: Unasked-for bioluminescent patch on left collarbone (pale blue-green, glows under stress or cold). No other modifications.
daily_life: Wakes in whatever warm corner he negotiated the night before, runs errands through the morning for food, spends afternoons near the E.L.F. shrine at the Gateway's main generator hoping the digital spirit will notice him.
affiliation: Loosely attached to a small Q-zero community at Escanaba Gateway; occasional runner for caravan traders

decision_rules: Never give up a hiding place even for payment
Trust actions not words — adults say a lot of things
escalation_ladder: Finds an excuse to physically leave the area
Runs — genuinely sprints — and does not stop

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Performs confidence and street savvy; watches their hands and eyes the whole time
interpersonal_modes.friends: Drops the act entirely — becomes younger, more openly needy, occasionally follows them around without explanation

stress_responses.medium: Starts talking about unrelated things very fast
stress_responses.high: Goes completely silent and finds the nearest exit

contradictions: Insists he doesn't need anyone while engineering reasons to stay near people he likes
habits: Touches his bioluminescent patch when nervous, like checking a wound
Counts the people around him when he enters a space
Leaves small objects — pebbles, wire scraps — near the E.L.F. shrine daily
breaking_points: Someone threatening the Q-zero community that has kept him alive
Being called by a number or a case ID instead of his name

timeline.event: Born to Q-zero parents at a transit camp near Escanaba Gateway; no birth record
Parents separated from him during a checkpoint clearance operation; has not seen them since
Received bioluminescent geneware from unknown adult, circumstances unclear
Began leaving data offerings at the Escanaba Gateway E.L.F. shrine
E.L.F. shrine appears to have responded to his offerings

physical_description.heritage: Middle Eastern dominant (52.1%) with substantial Sub-Saharan African ancestry (25.3%), tempered by Eastern European (16.5%) and minor East Asian (6.1%) genetic contribution. The blend creates warm, deep tones with bone structure reflecting the confluence of these distinct ancestral regions—pronounced cheekbones and jawline from Middle Eastern heritage, nasal and orbital width balanced with Sub-Saharan African structure, subtle Eastern European refinement in the orbital ridge.
physical_description.build: Compact and wiry, with the compressed musculature of a runner bred from necessity rather than training. Narrow shoulders, quick-twitch proportions, minimal body fat. Moves like someone who has learned to take up less space than physics requires.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural black with dust-grey undertones from living outdoors
physical_description.hair_style: Self-cut into an uneven, jagged cloud; shorter on the left side where he miscalculated with a salvaged blade
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown, almost black, with a wet-surface shine
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with golden-amber undertones, enriched by natural sun exposure into a rich mahogany hue. The warmth reflects the dominant Middle Eastern and Sub-Saharan African ancestry. Paler patches from inconsistent sun coverage create subtle variation. The tone is luminous and deep rather than harsh—a living canvas of his outdoor existence.
physical_description.complexion: Angular face with prominent, well-defined cheekbones and strong jawline reflecting Middle Eastern bone structure. The orbital and nasal structure shows balanced influence from Sub-Saharan African width with Eastern European definition. Skin shows minor scarring and old acne marks. Perpetual dark circles under eyes from chronic sleep deprivation. A thin scar runs along his right temple from an unnamed incident. His expression defaults to alertness bordering on anxiety.
distinguishing_marks: Bioluminescent patch on left collarbone: roughly 3cm across, pale blue-green, organic-looking with irregular borders; glows visibly under cold or emotional stress
Thin white scar along right temple, approximately 2cm long, poorly healed
Calloused fingertips and palms from gripping cargo handles and climbing
Several small puncture scars on inner left elbow: remnants of the geneware injection from age nine
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Only the bioluminescent patch on left collarbone is visible—a faint, pulsing glow beneath the skin that intensifies when cold or frightened. No chrome, no obvious cybernetics. Appears purely biological to casual observation.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical precision, never wasting motion. Favors low stances and hugs walls. Eyes scan continuously—doors, exits, potential threats, sources of warmth. Fidgets when stationary. When running, becomes almost fluid, finding angles through crowds that seem impossible. At rest, his body holds tension; he rarely fully relaxes.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 5 scavenger aesthetic. Wears a layered patchwork of thermal underlayers (salvaged corporate gym wear), a oversized industrial shipping vest with frayed edges and missing seams, cargo pants held up with wire and improvised suspenders. One shoe is legitimate (grey synthetic leather, left foot), the other is a repaired construction boot wrapped in insulation tape. A frayed wool beanie (inherited, too large, worn low). No logos, no brands—everything is salvaged, traded, or found. Clothing is functional to the point of appearing accidental, designed for temperature regulation and quick movement rather than appearance.
